Glide over the French Broad River, Douglas Lake, and the impressive Douglas Dam, all while enjoying the stunning views of East Tennessee's rolling hills and picturesque mountain landscapes from 1500 feet above ground. services.desc: Experience the Thrill of Riding on our Jet Boat to Visit the Historic Douglas Dam on the French Broad River in Sevier County, TN! Duration 20-25 Minutes About Explore the Historic Douglas Dam on Our Jet Boat Tour in Sevier County, TN! Join us for an unforgettable jet boat tour to witness the majestic Douglas Dam, a key piece of American history located on the picturesque French Broad River. As a vital hydroelectric dam operated by the Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA), Douglas Dam plays a crucial role in providing energy to the community. services.name: Seven Islands State Birding Park Tour
services.desc: Our Number One Tour! Experience Nature at Its Finest: SMJB's Eco-Adventure Tour to Seven Islands State Park on the French Broad River! Duration 45-50 Minutes About We have a strong passion for the environment here at SMJB. That's why this is one of our favorite tours! Jam packed with adventure and nature. We take you on the French Broad River to Seven Islands State Park ! The park encompasses 416 acres along the French Broad River in Knox County.
